headline: WE ARE BACK Playboi Carti shared new footage of himself and Ye performing together at Comp
body: WE ARE BACK Playboi Carti shared new footage of himself and Ye performing together at ComplexCon and he posted it on his burner account Video by: The clips give fans another look at their reunion onstage, where Ye brought Carti out and the two performed “Carnival” together. After nearly three years without sharing a stage, seeing them back in that moment has fans feeling like things are finally coming full circle What a moment for Ye and Carti fans.

WE ARE BACK 🥹🔥

Playboi Carti shared new footage of himself and Ye performing together at ComplexCon and he posted it on his burner account 👀🔥 

Video by: @directedbyfrankie 

The clips give fans another look at their reunion onstage, where Ye brought Carti out and the two performed “Carnival” together. After nearly three years without sharing a stage, seeing them back in that moment has fans feeling like things are finally coming full circle 🥹 What a moment for Ye and Carti fans.
